workProduct.subject: ALD-1042 case briefing: open request N-101 (signed office note)
workProduct.body:
Snapshot facts
- Case: ALD-1042; submitted package: PKG-1042; open request: N-101. 
- N-101 requests the signed office note and its signature page; a cover sheet or unsigned note does not satisfy the request. 
- Inventory (INV-1042) currently lists a cover sheet, demographic form and an unsigned office note. 
- The office has reported staff are checking with the clinician about the signature. 
- No receiving-team acknowledgment of the signed-note receipt, no receiving-team completeness review, and no payer decision are recorded in the case.

Immediate objective and blocker
- Objective: obtain the complete signed office note (including its signature page) and a clear receiving-team record of receipt/completeness. 
- Blocker: the signed note and signature page are missing from recorded package contents; the unsigned note already present does not satisfy N-101.

Open questions to ask the office (for the next conversation)
1) Can the office provide the complete signed office note including the signature page? If yes, please send it through the office’s established secure document channel and reference ALD-1042 / N-101. 
2) If the office already transmitted the signed note, what are the transmission details we can use to locate it? Provide the reported submission time, secure channel used, and any transmission/reference ID. 
3) Is every page of the signed note included and legible (no cropping), and does the signature page belong to that same note file? 
4) Is any part of N-101 unclear to the office or is an alternative acceptable (note: an unsigned note or cover sheet does not satisfy the request)? 
5) Can the office label the file with ALD-1042 / N-101 on resubmission to help reconcile duplicates?

What a later update must include
- An office report that documents a reported submission (with transmission details if available), AND
- A receiving-team acknowledgment that they recorded receipt, AND
- A receiving-team review stating whether the document is complete for N-101. 
- Any payer decision would require its own recorded payer event; none is recorded now.

Notes for Avery
- Treat office-reported transmission details as reported until the receiving team confirms receipt. 
- Do not recreate clinical text or signatures from incomplete scans; request a full, legible signed note via the secure channel.
